source: SRS/Abdallah Namoura SRS 2.0.pdf, section 5.1.4 System Requirements
statusRule: pass only when every listed automated test passes; absent or failing tests are fail

requirements.requirement: Enforce user authentication before granting access to protected functions
tests: backend/test/systemRequirements.test.js: SR-1 protected authentication accepts only a valid token for an active persisted session
backend/test/transactionRoutes.test.js: authenticated send returns 202 using injected verification and RPC dependencies within two seconds

requirements.requirement: Process cryptocurrency transfer requests through Ethereum-compatible smart contracts on the configured BSC network
tests: backend/test/systemRequirements.test.js: SR-2 EVM/BSC transfers invoke the payable remittance smart contract and retain its hash
backend/test/transactionConsistency.test.js: pending blockchain submission retains MongoDB transfer fields and submission timestamp

requirements.requirement: Store user, wallet, transaction, and system log data persistently in MongoDB
tests: backend/test/systemRequirements.test.js: SR-3 user, wallet, transaction, and system-log data have persistent MongoDB models
backend/test/transactionConsistency.test.js: successful blockchain result synchronizes MongoDB status, hash, block, and timestamps

requirements.requirement: Remain accessible through a modern JavaScript browser with wallet-provider integration
tests: frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: wallet UI reports no connection and a missing provider
frontend/e2e/user-requirements.spec.js: wallet UI reports a rejected connection request
frontend/e2e/notification-sla.spec.js: wallet connection success notification appears within 2 seconds
